propositions: The plan-writing guide does not document the 15 registered coaching moves from coach_moves.py, leaving coached authors with no reference for the techniques they are asked to apply.

The top five moves by field frequency are specification-by-example (150), plan-the-verification (96), riskiest-assumption-test (51), state-attestation-evidence (41), and propagate-to-children (22), but only state-attestation-evidence's [operator-attested] tag is observable in the guide.

A new 'Responding to coaching moves' section must be added to writing-a-passing-plan.md with technique descriptions and before/after examples for the top five moves in frequency order, plus a one-line index of the remaining moves.
The guide section must include exact MOVE_REGISTRY spellings, the [operator-attested] tag documentation, and cross-links from the existing advisory section.
Unit tests must assert the section's presence, move-name spellings, example blocks, frequency order, and tag documentation.
